name: Huawei Cloud CodeArts Agent
short: Huawei Cloud's AI coding agent (AI IDE, VS Code & JetBrains extensions, CLI/TUI) built around Z.ai's GLM-5.2 (1M-token context). Free Edition is auto-activated on login with a monthly token quota and limited core capabilities; paid tiers scale the quota and add enterprise management.

plans.name: Free Edition
plans.notes: 5M tokens/month; 5,000 codebase-index files; 500 MB knowledge space; limited access to core agent capabilities (Q&A / Coding / MCP / Rules / Skills); built-in GLM models (flagship GLM-5.2). Auto-activated on login (no order needed); up to 50 seats.

plans.name: Basic Edition
plans.notes: 40M tokens/seat/month; 50,000 codebase-index files; 5 GB knowledge space; all Free features plus agent center and skill/rule center.

plans.name: Professional Edition
plans.notes: 150M tokens/seat/month; 100,000 codebase-index files; 20 GB knowledge space; all Basic features plus operation logs, model management, enterprise custom models, usage management and SSO.
